# Feature Request

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the chore or pain point this solves (e.g. "I am always frustrated when...").

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what feature or indicator you would like to see added.

## EVE Domain & ESI Details

- **Relevant ESI Endpoints / Scopes**: (e.g. `/characters/{id}/planets/`, `/corporations/{id}/structures/`)
- **Traffic Light Impact**: How should this affect the Red / Yellow / Green dashboard indicator?

## Alternative Approaches

A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, screenshots, or additional context about the feature request here.
